population.independent_unit_definition: Whole connected declared physical/sample/individual/reference/group dependency component; conditional real-world independence

classification_evidence.interpretation: Exploratory operational classification at frozen scales; no target association or causal shortcut conclusion

limitations: Exploratory operational structural classification, not a universal taxonomy or shortcut probability.
Declared components do not independently establish biological or laboratory independence.
Native MST ties and PCA solver depend on deterministic canonical order; label values are arbitrary.
Membership strengths and resampling support are not calibrated probabilities.
All noise or a trivial cluster cannot establish robust structure. Test PCA projection does not assign HDBSCAN membership.
